about_the_game:
You are the captain, not just a ship.

Step into the boots of a daring privateer in Gierki's Pirates!, an open-world adventure inspired by the legendary Sid Meier’s Pirates!. The seas are wide, the choices are yours, and every voyage tells a different story.

Naval Combat – Ship fires cannons, water splashes, sails flutter.

Thrilling Broadsides

Command every battle with skill and strategy. Maneuver your ship with precision, unleash broadsides, and board rival vessels for plunder and glory.

Open World Sailing – Camera pans across different biomes (tropics, icy regions, volcanic island).

A Vast, Living World

Sail through icy northern waters with drifting glaciers, golden deserts with bustling ports, lush tropical archipelagos, hidden jungle rivers, and fiery volcanic islands alive with danger. Every region brings unique cultures, goods, and challenges.

Boarding Action – Captain jumps onto the enemy ship.

Choices & Reputation

Every decision shapes your reputation and your crew’s loyalty. Will you trade, raid, negotiate, or hunt for treasure? Rise as a wealthy merchant, a feared privateer, or a hero sung in every tavern.

Harbor Life – Docking in a bustling harbor, crew walking around.

Trade, Diplomacy, and Harbor Life

Dock at thriving ports to trade, recruit crew, and negotiate. The harbor is where fortunes are made, alliances are forged, and rumors of treasure set your next course.

Upgrade – Shows ship being enhanced in a timelapse.

Improve Your Ship

Equip better cannons, stronger hulls, extra crew capacity, and specialized ammo. Upgrades change how your ship performs in battle, giving you more options and letting each vessel feel distinct.

Customization – Shows changing colors of sails, railings, plates, and lights.Create Your Signature LookChoose colors and visual details to make your ship instantly recognizable on the seas. Personalize and build your own unique branding, so other captains will know your ship and your reputation from afar.

Captain Focus – Close-up of the captain at the helm or writing maps to show that you are the character.

You Are the Captain

It’s not just about steering a ship, it’s about leading your crew. From daring duels against rival captains to choices of romance or plunder, every action builds the legend of your name.

Gierki's Pirates! captures the freedom and playful spirit of classic pirate adventures, while putting you, the captain, firmly at the helm. The world is vast, the wind is strong, and destiny waits beyond the next horizon.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-kompatibel
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 7745HX or Intel Core i7-12700H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700M
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-kompatibel

short_description: Gierki's Pirates! is an open-world pirate adventure inspired by the classic Sid Meier’s Pirates! As a free captain, you explore a seamless open-world filled with rival nations, pirates, and trade routes. Capture ships, raid towns, trade goods. Shape the course of your story.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain
